articles.summary: The Partnership Will Support Filmmakers Worldwide Through Original Short Films Inspired by Merrell’s “It Starts Outside” Global Brand Platform ROCKFORD, MI, Oct. 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Merrell , the global leader in outdoor footwear, and Sundance Collab, the Sundance Institute's digital learning platform for filmmakers worldwide, today announced a three-year global storytelling partnership, bringing Merrell’s global brand platform, It Starts Outside, to life through original social-first films created by filmmakers around the world. “Sundance Collab is a perfect partner for It Starts Outside because it brings together world-class filmmakers from different backgrounds, each with a distinct way of telling stories,” said Richard McLeod, Chief Marketing Officer at Merrell. “When we introduced It Starts Outside earlier this year, we shared our belief that even the simplest moments outdoors can spark something meaningful. (NYSE: WWW) today announced that it expects to report its third quarter fiscal 2026 financial results on Thursday, November 12, 2026, at approximately 6:30 a.m. ET. Following the press release, the Company will host a conference call at 8:30 a.m. ET to review results and discuss current business trends. Investors and analysts interested in joining the call are invited to dial 1-833-461-5787 (international callers, please dial 1-585-542-9983) and enter Meeting ID 204388096 when prompted. Please dial in approximately five minutes prior to the start of the call. The conference call will be broadcast live and available for replay within approximately 30 minutes after the conclusion of the call through November 12, 2027, at investors.wolverineworldwide.com under “Events Presentations”. articles.summary: New capsule blends Caterpillar's legacy of durability with Swarovski's renowned craftsmanship in the "Built to Shine" campaign Rockford, MI, Oct. 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Cat Footwear today announced the launch of a limited-edition footwear collection embellished with crystals by Swarovski®, marking the latest ingredient branding partnership for the global footwear brand inspired by Caterpillar's heritage of strength, innovation and performance. Accompanied by the new "Built to Shine" campaign, the collection celebrates the unexpected fusion of industrial durability and elevated style, bringing together two iconic brands known for their commitment to quality craftsmanship. The ingredients partnership unites Swarovski's legacy of precision crystal expertise and pioneering design with Caterpillar's reputation for engineering excellence.
